snp5.11:1.1: Kappamāṇavapucchā (10). "Majjhe sarasmiṃ tiṭṭhataṃ icc-āyasmā Kappo oghe jāte mahabbhaye jarāmaccuparetānaṃ dīpaṃ pabrūhi mārisa, tvañ ca me dīpam akkhāhi, yatha-y-idaṃ nāparaṃ siyā". || ||
snp5.11:2.1: "Majjhe sarasmiṃ tiṭṭhataṃ kappā ti Bhagavā oghe jāte mahabbhaye jarāmaccuparetānaṃ dīpaṃ pabrūmi Kappa te || ||
snp5.11:3.1: akiñcanaṃ anādānaṃ etaṃ dīpaṃ anāparaṃ, nibbānaṃ iti naṃ brūmi, jarāmaccuparikkhayaṃ. || ||
snp5.11:4.1: Etad aññāya ye satā diṭṭhadhammābhinibbutā, na te Māra-vasānugā, na te Mārassa paddhagū" ti || || KAPPAMĀṆAVAPUCCHĀ
